note: Opt-in only. Nothing here is switched on by cloning this repository. See docs/DEVELOPER-TOOLKIT.md.

tools.name: Caveman
tools.why: The project's token saver, from the owner's fork of JuliusBrussee/caveman. Rules for its use are in AGENTS.md section 0.1.

tools.name: Ponytail
tools.runs_on_its_own: SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit (loads its rules, tracks its mode)
tools.why: The project's code minimiser, from the owner's fork of DietrichGebert/ponytail. Rules for its use are in AGENTS.md section 0.1.

tools.name: Superpowers
tools.why: Planning, test-first and systematic debugging as skills the agent reaches for. One hook, at session start, that only adds text. Installed from Anthropic's official directory, as its own README says; the commit recorded is the one read on the day it was reviewed.

tools.name: Anthropic skills
tools.licence: per skill (some source-available, not open source)
tools.why: Anthropic's own skills. document-skills makes the PDF and Word copies of the guides in docs/handbook without new code here. Read each skill's own licence before copying it into this AGPL repository: some may be used but not redistributed.

tools.name: Codex plugin for Claude Code
tools.runs_on_its_own: SessionStart, Stop, SessionEnd (starts and stops its helper)
tools.why: Claude and Codex already share this repository (AGENTS.md section 7). This lets one hand a review to the other without leaving the session. Needs the developer's own Codex sign-in.

tools.name: Claude HUD
tools.runs_on_its_own: a status-line command, each time the line is drawn
tools.why: Shows how much of the context and the budget a session has used, which is the number Caveman is there to bring down.

tools.name: Repomix
tools.why: Packs the repository into one file for a review or a second opinion. It follows .gitignore, so .env files and build output stay out. Run on demand, at a pinned version, never installed into package.json.

tools.name: CodeGraph
tools.why: A local index of the code that an agent can search instead of reading whole files: fewer tokens on a repository this size. Stays on the developer's machine.

tools.name: Taste
tools.why: A design skill for pages that look finished. docs/VISUAL-LANGUAGE.md outranks it whenever they disagree: navy is the only press-me colour, drawn icons, nothing read under 13px.

tools.name: Claude plugin directory
tools.why: Anthropic's own directory. The place to find anything not listed here; whatever is taken from it is added to this list first, with what it runs.

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.why: Every screen is already walked in a real browser by tests/e2e (Chromium here, WebKit in CI), and agents run those walks. A second way to drive a browser would be a second thing to trust.

tools.name: GitHub MCP server
tools.why: Cloud sessions already have GitHub through their own connector, and a local developer has the gh command.

tools.name: Karpathy skills
tools.why: One CLAUDE.md of general rules. This project's AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are that, written from its own mistakes. There is also no licence to reuse it under.

tools.name: Learn Claude Code
tools.why: A small harness to read and learn from. The project's harness is AGENTS.md plus the verify gate.

tools.name: Claude Code best practice
tools.why: A guide, and a set of hooks on nine events. AGENTS.md is this project's practice, and nothing here needs hooks on nine events.

tools.name: Planning with files
tools.why: Plans that survive a restart are what the reports in reports/llm/ and AGENTS.md already do, without hooks on six events.

tools.name: Everything Claude Code (ECC)
tools.runs_on_its_own: six hook events, plus its own MCP servers
tools.why: About 4,000 files and hooks on six events. Sessions here touch live pastoral data; a harness that size cannot be read before it is trusted.

tools.name: gstack
tools.runs_on_its_own: none found in its plugin files
tools.why: Twenty-five opinionated tools in about 2,800 files, most of them overlapping the verify gate and AGENTS.md.

tools.name: UI UX Pro Max
tools.why: A second design skill beside Taste. One is enough, and docs/VISUAL-LANGUAGE.md outranks both.

tools.name: claude-mem
tools.why: It records every session into a memory store. Sessions here read live member data, so that would be a second copy of it on a laptop, outside the church's control. Not for this project.

tools.name: graphify
tools.why: A codebase map, the same job as CodeGraph. One index is enough.

tools.name: Agents marketplace
tools.runs_on_its_own: PreToolUse and PostToolUse in some plugins
tools.why: A marketplace of many agents. Take a single agent through the official directory if one is ever needed, and list it here first.

tools.name: Claude Code Router
tools.why: Routes the session to other model providers, which sends whatever the session holds, live data included, to more companies.

tools.name: CC Switch
tools.why: A personal desktop app that keeps API keys for several agents. A developer's own choice, not part of this project's setup.

tools.name: Multica
tools.why: Sends one issue to many agents at once, in about 6,400 files. This project runs two agents on one branch by protocol (AGENTS.md section 7).

tools.name: Vibe Kanban
tools.why: A board for many agents' work, in about 2,200 files. Nothing here runs enough agents at once to need one.

tools.name: Firecrawl
tools.why: Web scraping through a hosted service and an API key. Nothing in this project scrapes the web.

tools.name: Awesome MCP servers
tools.why: A list, not a tool. A place to look; anything found there comes through this page first.

tools.name: Awesome Claude skills
tools.why: A list, not a tool. A place to look; anything found there comes through this page first.

tools.name: System prompts collection
tools.why: Other companies' system prompts, collected without a licence. Not something a public church project should build on.
